_note: Random encounters on the world map (rules/wandering.ts, house rules). chance = per step off the road (a zone may set its own), roadChance = on roads and bridges (0 = roads are safe), grace = quiet steps after an encounter. Zones by distance (squares) to the nearest town, cave, ruin or quest site, hidden ones included; the first zone that fits wins, so specific zones go first: near = measure within from one location/site id, area = {x:[min,max], y:[min,max]}, onlyRoads = road and bridge squares only (with roadChance). Each zone picks one of its dialogs (quests.json) and sets the fight's difficulty. share = most monsters as a share of the party size (1 = one per character).
